About DIIDS

DIIDS is a premium underwear brand built for people who value confidence, comfort, and style every day. We make underwear and essentials for both men and women, designed around one simple idea: confidence starts with what you wear underneath.

Our mission

We exist to redefine everyday comfort. That means no compromises — premium fabrics that actually feel good against skin, cuts that fit real bodies, and construction that holds up wash after wash. Underwear isn't an afterthought at DIIDS; it's the foundation everything else is built on.

What we stand for

  • Premium fabrics. We choose materials for how they feel and perform, not just how they look on a rack — soft, breathable, and durable enough for daily wear.
  • Modern design. Clean lines and considered details, made for how people actually dress today.
  • Craftsmanship. Every piece is built to a standard, not a price point — consistent stitching, fit, and finish across every size we offer.
  • Comfort, honestly. No gimmicks. Just fabrics and fits that hold up to a full day, every day.

Made for everyone

Our men's and women's lines are each designed on their own terms — not a single unisex fit stretched across two catalogs. Sizing, cuts, and fabric choices are built around how men's and women's underwear actually needs to fit, so nothing feels like an afterthought.

Where we're headed

DIIDS is growing with the people who wear it. We're building a catalog rooted in the essentials — boxers, briefs, trunks, panties, bras, and shapewear — done properly, before we do anything else. Every new piece has to meet the same bar: fabric, fit, and finish worth wearing every single day.

Thank you for choosing DIIDS. If you have questions about our products, sizing, or anything else, our Customer Service team is always happy to help.

Returns & Refunds Policy

For health and hygiene reasons, we do not accept returns or refunds on opened underwear items. This applies to all products once removed from their original packaging or with a hygiene seal broken.

What counts as "unopened"

An item is eligible for return only if:

  • It is in its original, unopened packaging
  • Any hygiene seal is fully intact
  • It has not been worn, washed, or altered

Once packaging is opened or a hygiene seal is broken, the item cannot be returned or refunded — this is standard practice across the underwear and intimate apparel industry, and it protects the health and safety of all our customers.

Damaged, defective, or wrong item shipped

This hygiene policy does not leave you without options if something goes wrong on our end. If your order arrives damaged, defective, or if we shipped you the wrong item, contact us within 7 days of delivery and we will arrange an exchange or replacement at no cost to you. In cases where a replacement isn't possible, a refund will be issued instead.

To report a damaged, defective, or incorrect item, email us with your order number and a photo of the item received.

Before you order

Because opened items cannot be returned, please check size charts and product descriptions carefully before purchasing. If you're unsure about sizing, reach out to us before placing your order.

Summary

  • Opened or worn underwear: No returns, no refunds — for hygiene reasons.
  • Unopened, unworn, seal intact: Returns accepted within the standard return window.
  • Damaged, defective, or wrong item shipped: Always eligible for exchange, replacement, or refund, regardless of packaging state.

html_content:
Refund Policy

This page covers how refunds work at DIIDS. It should be read together with our Return Policy, which explains what items are eligible for return in the first place.

When a refund applies

  • Unopened, unworn items with the original packaging and hygiene seal intact, returned within the standard return window.
  • Damaged, defective, or incorrect items — always eligible, regardless of packaging state, if reported within 7 days of delivery.
  • Cancelled orders that haven't yet been shipped.

As stated in our Return Policy, opened or worn underwear cannot be returned or refunded, for hygiene reasons.

How refunds are issued

Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method via Paystack. Bank transfers and card refunds are typically processed by Paystack within 5–10 business days of approval, though your bank's own processing times may add a few extra days on their end.

How to request a refund

  1. Contact us at hello@diids.com with your order number and the reason for your request.
  2. For damaged, defective, or incorrect items, include a photo of what you received.
  3. We'll confirm eligibility and next steps — exchange, replacement, or refund — within 2 business days.

Partial orders

If only part of your order is eligible for a refund (for example, one item in a multi-item order), we'll refund that portion only, and let you know clearly what's been processed.

Questions

If you have questions about a specific refund, email us at hello@diids.com with your order number.

Terms & Conditions

These Terms & Conditions apply to every order placed through the DIIDS store. Please read them alongside our Terms of Use, Payment Policy, Shipping Policy, and Return Policy.

Orders

Placing an order through our store is an offer to purchase, which we may accept or decline. An order is confirmed once you receive an order confirmation email after successful payment. We reserve the right to cancel an order in cases of suspected fraud, pricing errors, or stock unavailability, and will notify you promptly if this happens.

Pricing

All prices are listed in Nigerian Naira (NGN) and are subject to change without notice. The price charged will always be the price displayed at the time your order is placed and confirmed.

Payment

Payments are processed securely through Paystack. See our Payment Policy for full details on accepted methods and payment security.

Shipping & delivery

Delivery timelines and costs are outlined in our Shipping Policy. Risk of loss and title for items purchased pass to you upon delivery to the shipping address provided.

Returns, refunds & hygiene policy

For health and hygiene reasons, we do not accept returns or refunds on opened underwear items. Full details, including what qualifies as "unopened" and how damaged or incorrect items are handled, are set out in our Return Policy and Refund Policy.

Limitation of liability

DIIDS is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our products or website, to the fullest extent permitted by law. Nothing in these terms limits any liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law.

Governing law

These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

Contact us

For any questions regarding these Terms & Conditions, contact us at hello@diids.com.

Terms of Use

These Terms of Use govern your use of the DIIDS website and storefront. By browsing or shopping with us, you agree to these terms.

Using our site

  • You must be legally able to enter into a binding contract to place an order with us.
  • You agree to provide accurate, current information when creating an account or placing an order.
  • You're responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for any activity under your account.

Product information

We make every effort to display our products, descriptions, and pricing accurately. Colors may vary slightly depending on your screen's display settings. If a product is listed at an incorrect price due to a technical or clerical error, we reserve the right to cancel the order and notify you before any charge is finalized.

Intellectual property

All content on this site — including the DIIDS name, logo, product photography, and written content — is the property of DIIDS and may not be copied, reproduced, or used commercially without our written permission.

Prohibited use

You agree not to use this site to:

  • Violate any applicable law or regulation
  • Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems or another user's account
  • Interfere with the normal operation of the store
  • Submit false or fraudulent orders

Availability

We aim to keep the site available at all times, but we don't guarantee uninterrupted access. We may suspend or restrict access for maintenance, updates, or reasons outside our control.

Changes to these terms

We may update these Terms of Use as our store evolves. Continued use of the site after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.

Contact us

Questions about these terms can be sent to hello@diids.com.

Customer Service

We're here to help with anything you need — sizing questions, order updates, or issues with a delivery. Here's how to reach us and what to expect.

Contact us

  • Email: hello@diids.com
  • Response time: within 1–2 business days

Order help

Have a question about an order? Include your order number when you contact us so we can look into it quickly. You can also check order status any time from your account dashboard.

Sizing help

Not sure which size to pick? Check the size guide on each product page before ordering. If you're still unsure, email us your usual size in other brands and we'll help you find the closest match in DIIDS sizing.

Damaged, defective, or incorrect items

If something isn't right with your order, contact us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and a photo of the item. We'll arrange an exchange, replacement, or refund at no cost to you. See our Return Policy for full details.

Before you order

Please note that for health and hygiene reasons, opened underwear items cannot be returned or refunded. Review our Return Policy before placing your order if you have any doubts.

Other questions

For anything else — product questions, bulk or gifting enquiries, or general feedback — reach out to hello@diids.com. We'd love to hear from you.

Payment Policy

We want paying for your order to be simple and secure. Here's how payments work at DIIDS.

Accepted payment methods

We accept payments via Paystack, supporting:

  • Debit and credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Verve)
  • Bank transfer
  • USSD

All payments are processed in Nigerian Naira (₦).

Payment security

All transactions are processed securely through Paystack's encrypted payment gateway. DIIDS does not receive or store your full card or bank account details at any point — that information is handled entirely by Paystack, a licensed and PCI-DSS compliant payment processor.

When you're charged

Payment is captured at the time of checkout, once your payment method has been successfully verified. You'll receive an order confirmation email as soon as payment is confirmed.

Failed or declined payments

If a payment fails or is declined, your order will not be placed and no funds will be deducted. Please check your card details, available balance, or try an alternative payment method. If you believe a payment was deducted but your order wasn't confirmed, contact us immediately with your transaction reference so we can investigate.

Pricing & currency

All prices displayed on the store are in Nigerian Naira (NGN) and are inclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise at checkout. Shipping costs, if any, are shown separately before you complete your order.

Questions about a payment

If you have any questions or concerns about a payment on your account, contact us at hello@diids.com with your order number and we'll help sort it out.

Shipping Policy

We currently ship across Nigeria, with plans to expand delivery across the wider African region as we grow.

Processing time

Orders are processed within 1–2 business days of payment confirmation. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed on the next business day.

Delivery times

  • Within Lagos: 1–3 business days
  • Other states in Nigeria: 3–7 business days

Delivery times are estimates and may vary depending on your location, courier availability, and factors outside our control (e.g. weather, public holidays, or courier delays).

Shipping costs

Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your delivery address. Any current shipping promotions (such as free shipping thresholds) will be clearly shown at checkout and in the cart.

Order tracking

Once your order has shipped, you'll receive a confirmation email. If tracking is available for your courier, tracking details will be included so you can follow your delivery.

Delayed or missing orders

If your order hasn't arrived within the expected delivery window, contact us with your order number and we'll look into it with our courier partner on your behalf.

Incorrect delivery address

Please double-check your shipping address before completing your order. We aren't able to redirect a package once it has shipped, so if you spot an error immediately after ordering, contact us right away and we'll do our best to update it before dispatch.

Questions

For any shipping questions, reach out to us at hello@diids.com.

Privacy Policy

DIIDS ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, and how it's used and protected.

Information we collect

  • Account & order information: name, email address, phone number, shipping and billing address, and order history.
  • Payment information: payment details are processed directly by our payment provider, Paystack — DIIDS does not store your card or bank details on our own servers.
  • Browsing information: pages viewed, products browsed, and general device/browser information, used to keep the store working properly and to improve your shopping experience.

How we use your information

  • To process and deliver your orders
  • To send order confirmations and shipping updates
  • To respond to customer service requests
  • To send marketing communications, but only if you've opted in (e.g. via the newsletter sign-up) — you can unsubscribe at any time
  • To improve our products, catalog, and storefront experience

How we protect your information

We use industry-standard safeguards to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse. Payment transactions are handled by Paystack over encrypted connections; DIIDS staff never see or store your full card details.

Sharing your information

We do not sell your personal information. We share information only where necessary to fulfil your order or run the store — for example, with our payment processor (Paystack) to complete a transaction, or with courier partners to deliver your order. We do not share your information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

Your rights

You can request a copy of the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct inaccurate information, or ask us to delete your account and associated data, subject to any legal or accounting obligations we must retain records for. To make a request, contact us using the details below.

Cookies

We use cookies to keep your cart and session working correctly, remember your preferences, and understand how the store is used so we can improve it. You can control cookies through your browser settings, though disabling them may affect parts of the shopping experience.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time as our store and services evolve. Changes will be posted on this page.

Contact us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, contact us at hello@diids.com.
